_comment: wall_painting2: two-handed roller. `two_hand` runs the shaft axis between the right
and left wrist links so the roller follows the two-hand motion throughout the clip.
The roller shaft is aligned with its local +Z axis. `axis_offset` places the roller
origin 0.700 m from the right wrist along the right-to-left wrist direction.
target offsets are -0.700 m and -0.197 m along the roller local Z axis.
grip_offset is omitted, so the wrist link origins are used directly as the two grip
points. The roller remains in contact with both hands throughout the reference motion.

contact_target_pos_offset is ordered [left, right] to match contact_eef_body_name in base/hdmi-base.yaml. right_wrist_yaw_link sits at local z = -axis_offset = -0.700; left at -0.197. These were swapped until 2026-09-29, which put each hand on the other's grip point (0.503 m error) and made every episode terminate on lost contact at the 25-step floor.
